section_summary.extract_value: This Conclusions section discusses findings from a single study examining body image flexibility and positive body image strategies among Black and ethnic minority young women. The study appears to be the first to incorporate body image flexibility into positive body image assessment and focuses on how these self-regulatory strategies may protect against disordered eating, with particular emphasis on overweight and obese Black young women transitioning to college life.
section_summary.evidence_source: Entire Conclusions section, particularly: 'To our knowledge, this study is the first to incorporate body image flexibility within the broader scope of positive body image assessment' and references to 'Black females' and 'ethnic minority young women about to enter college.'
section_summary.warning: This is a Conclusions section only; most quantitative data (sample size, demographics, correlations) would be found in Methods and Results sections, not here.
